New Azure SQL databases have Query Store {{c1::enabled by default}}.
column2:
New SQL Server 2025 databases also enable Query Store by default in READ_WRITE mode.
Review source

column1: To force plan 17 for query 42, run {{c1::EXEC sys.sp_query_store_force_plan @query_id = 42, @plan_id = 17;}}
column2:
The plan must belong to the specified Query Store query.
Review source

column1: To stop forcing plan 17 for query 42, run {{c1::EXEC sys.sp_query_store_unforce_plan @query_id = 42, @plan_id = 17;}}
column2:
The optimizer can choose another plan for future executions.
Review source

column1: Apply MAXDOP 1 to captured query 42 with {{c1::EXEC sys.sp_query_store_set_hints @query_id = 42, @query_hints = N'OPTION (MAXDOP 1)';}}
column2:
This requests serial query execution without changing the application's SQL text.
Review source

column1: Remove Query Store hints from query 42 with {{c1::EXEC sys.sp_query_store_clear_hints @query_id = 42;}}
column2:
Clearing hints does not remove the query's captured performance history.
Review source

column1: In Azure SQL Database, enable Query Store wait collection with {{c1::ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET QUERY_STORE (WAIT_STATS_CAPTURE_MODE = ON);}}
column2:
Wait history helps associate resource waits with specific queries and plans.
Review source

column1: Query Store's query text is available in {{c1::sys.query_store_query_text}}.
column2:
Join to sys.query_store_query on query_text_id to obtain query metadata and query_id.
Review source

column1: Query Store's execution counts and aggregate durations are available in {{c1::sys.query_store_runtime_stats}}.
column2:
Join to sys.query_store_plan on plan_id, then to sys.query_store_query on query_id.
Review source

column1: The avg_duration column in sys.query_store_runtime_stats uses {{c1::microseconds}}.
column2:
Divide by 1,000 for milliseconds when presenting the raw catalog value.
Review source

column1: Inspect plan-forcing failures in {{c1::sys.query_store_plan}} using force_failure_count and last_force_failure_reason_desc.
column2:
A plan marked is_forced_plan is not proof that forcing always succeeds.
Review source

column1: When Query Store switches to {{c1::READ_ONLY}}, it stops collecting new query data.
column2:
Previously captured history remains available for review.
Review source

column1: In Azure SQL Database, raise Query Store's quota to 1,024 MB with {{c1::ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET QUERY_STORE (MAX_STORAGE_SIZE_MB = 1024);}}
column2:
Choose a quota that fits the workload and available database storage.
Review source

column1: In QPI, the top line shows overall database {{c1::DTU percentage}}, while query bars show CPU consumption.
column2:
The DTU line uses hourly maximums, so do not equate it with query CPU averages.
Review source

column1: QPI's Custom tab can rank queries by CPU, duration, or {{c1::execution count}}.
column2:
Choose the metric and aggregation that fit the issue you are investigating.
Review source

column1: QPI chart annotations show recommendations from {{c1::Database Advisor}}.
column2:
Select an annotation to review the recommendation's details.
Review source
